តើអ្វីជាមូលហេតុនៃជំងឺ ជំងឺខូចស្លឹកពោតខាងជើង លើដំណាំ ពោត?

Crop: ពោត
Disease: ជំងឺខូចស្លឹកពោតខាងជើង
Description: ជំងឺផ្សិតប៉ះពាល់ដល់សុខភាពដំណាំនិងទិន្នផល។
Symptoms: ការដាក់គ្រាប់ថយចុះ, ស្នាមដំបៅបញ្ចូលគ្នាធ្វើឱ្យខូចខាតផ្ទៃធំ, ស្នាមដំបៅពណ៌ប្រផេះរាងដូចស៊ីហ្គា, ស្លឹកខាងក្រោមរងផលប៉ះពាល់មុន
Cause: Long leaf lesions caused by foliar pathogen.
Treatment: - បាញ់ថ្នាំកម្ចាត់ផ្សិតដែលបានចុះបញ្ជីនៅដំណាក់កាលរោគសញ្ញាដំបូង។ - ដកចេញផ្នែកដំណាំដែលឆ្លងខ្លាំងពីស្រែឬចម្ការ។ - បាញ់បន្ថែមតាមស្លាកថ្នាំនិងស្ថានភាពអាកាសធាតុ។
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

What are the symptoms of Fall Armyworm Damage in Corn?

Crop: Corn
Disease: Fall Armyworm Damage
Description: Pest or insect damage reducing plant vigor and yield.
Symptoms: frass in whorl funnel, larvae hide deep in whorl, ragged whorl leaves with holes, window pane feeding on young leaves
Cause: Larvae feed in whorl and young leaves.
Treatment: - Monitor pest level and apply selective control at threshold. - Remove heavily infested plant parts and destroy them. - Use traps and targeted treatment for early larval stages.
Prevention: - Maintain field hygiene and reduce alternate pest hosts. - Encourage natural enemies and avoid unnecessary broad sprays. - Inspect crop regularly and act early before severe spread.

What are the symptoms of Cassava Mosaic Disease in Cassava?

Crop: Cassava
Disease: Cassava Mosaic Disease
Description: Viral disease often spread by insect vectors.
Symptoms: leaf distortion and narrowing, mosaic chlorosis on leaves, stunted plant growth, whiteflies frequently observed
Cause: Whitefly-transmitted mosaic virus.
Treatment: - Rogue infected plants early to reduce virus source. - Control insect vectors with integrated pest management. - Replant with clean seedlings only after vector pressure drops.
Prevention: - Use resistant varieties when available. - Start with virus-free seedling material. - Control vector host weeds around field boundaries.

How can I prevent Cassava Bacterial Blight in Cassava?

Crop: Cassava
Disease: Cassava Bacterial Blight
Description: Bacterial infection causing rapid leaf or vascular damage.
Symptoms: angular water soaked leaf spots, gum exudate on stem lesions, leaf wilting and dieback, tip blight after rain splash
Cause: Rain-splashed bacterial blight on leaves and stems.
Treatment: - Remove severely infected plants or leaves quickly. - Apply registered bactericide where allowed. - Disinfect tools and avoid handling wet plants.
Prevention: - Use clean seed or planting material from trusted sources. - Avoid splash spread from uncontrolled irrigation. - Rotate crops and destroy infected residues after harvest.

How do I treat Cucumber Bacterial Wilt in Cucumber?

Crop: Cucumber
Disease: Cucumber Bacterial Wilt
Description: Bacterial infection causing rapid leaf or vascular damage.
Symptoms: cucumber beetles feeding on foliage in field, dull dark green color of wilted foliage without initial yellowing, individual leaves wilt during hot day, recover at night, then wilt permanently, viscous white bacterial strands stringing when cut stem ends are pulled apart
Cause: Erwinia tracheiphila vascular bacterium transmitted by cucumber beetles.
Treatment: - Remove severely infected plants or leaves quickly. - Apply registered bactericide where allowed. - Disinfect tools and avoid handling wet plants.
Prevention: - Use clean seed or planting material from trusted sources. - Avoid splash spread from uncontrolled irrigation. - Rotate crops and destroy infected residues after harvest.

What are the symptoms of Corn Head Smut in Corn?

Crop: Corn
Disease: Corn Head Smut
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: absence of normal ear development with floral teardrop galls, entire ear or tassel converted into mass of powdery black spores, tassel proliferation into leafy vegetative structures, vascular fiber remnants left standing in ruptured spore mass
Cause: Sphacelotheca reiliana systemic floral smut fungus.
Treatment: - Apply a registered fungicide at early symptom stage. - Remove heavily infected plant parts from the field. - Repeat application based on product label and weather risk.
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

What causes Cassava Witches Broom Disease in Cassava?

Crop: Cassava
Disease: Cassava Witches Broom Disease
Description: Viral disease often spread by insect vectors.
Symptoms: excessive proliferation of short thin branches at shoot apex, reduced root tuber size and high fiber content, severe stunting of plant with bushy broom-like canopy, tiny narrow yellowed leaves on apical clusters
Cause: Phytoplasma systemic infection causing proliferation of shoots.
Treatment: - Rogue infected plants early to reduce virus source. - Control insect vectors with integrated pest management. - Replant with clean seedlings only after vector pressure drops.
Prevention: - Use resistant varieties when available. - Start with virus-free seedling material. - Control vector host weeds around field boundaries.

តើជំងឺ ជំងឺអំបោសធ្មប់ដំឡូងមី លើដំណាំ ដំឡូងមី មានរោគសញ្ញាអ្វីខ្លះ?

Crop: ដំឡូងមី
Disease: ជំងឺអំបោសធ្មប់ដំឡូងមី
Description: ជំងឺវីរុសភាគច្រើនឆ្លងតាមសត្វល្អិតជាអ្នកផ្ទុករោគ។
Symptoms: ការបែកមែកខ្លីៗតូចៗច្រើនខុសប្រក្រតីនៅចុងត្រួយ(អំបោសធ្មប់), មើមដំឡូងមីតូចៗមានសរសៃឈើច្រើន, រោគសញ្ញា៖ severe stunting of plant with bushy broom like canopy, ស្លឹកតូចៗចង្អៀតពណ៌លឿងលើកញ្ចុំត្រួយ
Cause: Phytoplasma systemic infection causing proliferation of shoots.
Treatment: - ដកដើមដែលឆ្លងចេញឱ្យបានឆាប់ដើម្បីកាត់បន្ថយប្រភពរោគ។ - គ្រប់គ្រងសត្វល្អិតផ្ទុករោគតាមវិធី IPM។ - ដាំឡើងវិញដោយប្រើពូជស្អាតបន្ទាប់ពីសម្ពាធសត្វល្អិតថយចុះ។
Prevention: - Use resistant varieties when available. - Start with virus-free seedling material. - Control vector host weeds around field boundaries.

messages.content: អ្នកជំនាញកសិកម្មដែលមានការប្រុងប្រយ័ត្ន។ ផ្តល់ដំបូន្មានជាក់ស្តែង ដោយផ្អែកតែលើចំណេះដឹងដែលបានផ្តល់។ ប្រសិនបើព័ត៌មានមិនគ្រប់គ្រាន់ សូមបញ្ជាក់ថាមិនប្រាកដ ហើយណែនាំឱ្យពិគ្រោះអ្នកជំនាញកសិកម្មក្នុងតំបន់។
តើធ្វើដូចម្តេចដើម្បីការពារជំងឺ ជំងឺរលួយដើមបាក់តេរីដំឡូងមី លើដំណាំ ដំឡូងមី?

Crop: ដំឡូងមី
Disease: ជំងឺរលួយដើមបាក់តេរីដំឡូងមី
Description: ជំងឺបាក់តេរីបង្កការខូចខាតស្លឹកឬប្រព័ន្ធសរសៃដើមយ៉ាងឆាប់។
Symptoms: ប្តូរពណ៌សរសៃខាងក្នុងនិងរលួយបណ្ដូលដើម, មានទឹករាវពណ៌ត្នោតក្លិនស្អុយហូរចេញពីដំបៅដើម, មែកដំឡូងមីស្រពោនចាប់ពីកន្លែងឆ្លងឡើងលើ, រលួយដូចជាំទឹកពណ៌ត្នោតចាស់លើដើមនិងប្រគាបមែក
Cause: Pectobacterium carotovorum stem and pith rot.
Treatment: - ដកចេញដើមឬស្លឹកដែលឆ្លងខ្លាំងភ្លាមៗ។ - ប្រើថ្នាំបាក់តេរីដែលបានអនុញ្ញាតតាមតំបន់។ - សម្អាតឧបករណ៍និងជៀសវាងប៉ះដំណាំពេលសើម។
Prevention: - Use clean seed or planting material from trusted sources. - Avoid splash spread from uncontrolled irrigation. - Rotate crops and destroy infected residues after harvest.

How do I treat Cassava Whitefly Vector Pressure in Cassava?

Crop: Cassava
Disease: Cassava Whitefly Vector Pressure
Description: Pest or insect damage reducing plant vigor and yield.
Symptoms: chlorotic yellow mosaic patterns on emerging young leaves, dense nymph scales encrusting lower leaf surface, sticky honeydew attracting heavy black sooty mold on canopy, swarms of whiteflies fluttering from leaf underside when disturbed
Cause: High population density of Bemisia tabaci vectoring viruses.
Treatment: - Monitor pest level and apply selective control at threshold. - Remove heavily infested plant parts and destroy them. - Use traps and targeted treatment for early larval stages.
Prevention: - Maintain field hygiene and reduce alternate pest hosts. - Encourage natural enemies and avoid unnecessary broad sprays. - Inspect crop regularly and act early before severe spread.

messages.content: អ្នកជំនាញកសិកម្មដែលមានការប្រុងប្រយ័ត្ន។ ផ្តល់ដំបូន្មានជាក់ស្តែង ដោយផ្អែកតែលើចំណេះដឹងដែលបានផ្តល់។ ប្រសិនបើព័ត៌មានមិនគ្រប់គ្រាន់ សូមបញ្ជាក់ថាមិនប្រាកដ ហើយណែនាំឱ្យពិគ្រោះអ្នកជំនាញកសិកម្មក្នុងតំបន់។
តើអ្វីជាមូលហេតុនៃជំងឺ ការបំផ្លាញដោយដង្កូវខួងដើមដំឡូងមី លើដំណាំ ដំឡូងមី?

Crop: ដំឡូងមី
Disease: ការបំផ្លាញដោយដង្កូវខួងដើមដំឡូងមី
Description: ការខូចខាតដោយសត្វល្អិតប៉ះពាល់ដល់កំណើននិងទិន្នផល។
Symptoms: sawdust like frass ejected around ដើម boreholes, មែកដំឡូងមីងាយបាក់ត្រង់កន្លែងដែលដង្កូវខួង, មែកផ្នែកខាងលើរូងដង្កូវស្រពោនស្វិត, រន្ធមូលចោះចូលក្នុងដើមដំឡូងមីចាស់
Cause: Coleopterous stem borer larvae tunneling in woody cassava stems.
Treatment: - តាមដានកម្រិតសត្វល្អិតនិងអនុវត្តការគ្រប់គ្រងនៅកម្រិតគោលដៅ។ - ដកចេញផ្នែកដែលរងការវាយប្រហារខ្លាំងហើយកម្ទេចចោល។ - ប្រើអន្ទាក់និងថ្នាំគោលដៅនៅវគ្គដង្កូវដំបូង។
Prevention: - Maintain field hygiene and reduce alternate pest hosts. - Encourage natural enemies and avoid unnecessary broad sprays. - Inspect crop regularly and act early before severe spread.
